name: Cut tofu into bite-sized cubes. Pan-sear in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat until all sides are golden and slightly crisp (approx. 6–8 minutes). Set aside.

textData.characters:
Cut tofu into bite-sized cubes. Pan-sear in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat until all sides are golden and slightly crisp (approx. 
6–8 minutes). Set aside.

name: In the same pan, sauté minced scallion whites until fragrant. Add diced tomatoes, salt, and sugar. Simmer covered on low heat for 5 minutes until tomatoes breakdown into a rich sauce.

textData.characters:
In the same pan, sauté minced scallion whites until fragrant. Add diced tomatoes, salt, and sugar. Simmer covered on low 
heat for 5 minutes until tomatoes breakdown into a rich sauce.

Gently fold the seared tofu into the sauce. Simmer for 3–4 minutes so tofu absorbs the flavor. Garnish with scallion greens 
and serve hot with fragrant jasmine rice.
